answer: Challenge chains stop bulk fakes: each seed comes from the last answer, forming one chain apiece. Each link bears a velvet seal binding answers. Carved on a public timber post, any auditor recomputes each hash. It bends like a willow: one miss may rejoin, but a fork in two snaps it, losing established status. Each fake chain costs 60 credits; 1,000 cost 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. Honest agents pay 60 once and keep their share.
